title: Polynomial-time fourth-power string map
statement: For a bit string $z$, let $a$ and $b$ be its decoded first and second components, taking either to be empty when decoding fails. Form the pair whose first component is $a$ and whose second component is four concatenated copies of $b$ if the length of that repeated string is at most the length of $a$; otherwise use $b$ as the second component. This function is polynomial-time computable.
